title: Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – May 9, 2019
raw_text: May 10, 2019 Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – May 9, 2019 A new patch is now live on Windows PC. Read below to learn more about the latest changes. To share your feedback, please post in the General Discussion forum For a list of known issues, visit our Bug Report forum. For troubleshooting assistance, visit our Technical Support forum. BUG FIXES Heroes Fixed a display issue with Mercy’s 2019 Atlantic All-Stars skin for computer using lower graphics settings
